observations: Object mappings name a dataset, primary key, and properties; relationships map source and target columns.
DuckDB executor runs declared-input SQL over versioned Parquet snapshots.
HelixDB stores workspace metadata, jobs, proposals, objects and edges.
Publication and edited overlays have hashes, input versions, generations, and audit history.
elf_relevance: External domain identities and typed relation ownership are useful contracts. Business ontology definitions, connector mappings, business metrics, and actions remain application-owned. No dependency adoption or Foundry runtime benchmark was performed.
